title.narrative: Output 7.2. Increased capacity of Member States to ensure safe and healthy working conditions

description.narrative:
Following the publication of the 2nd National OSH Profile in July 2022, the Government of Cambodia, in collaboration with the social partners, developed and adopted the 3rd National OSH Master Plan in July 2023 to further strengthen workplace safety standards. The 3rd National OSH Master Plan addresses six priority areas, namely, 3 system/infrastructure strategies (legislation, enforcement, institutional collaboration), 2 focused sectors (formal economy and SME, informal and rural economy), and 1 special subject strategy (child labour, HIV/AIDS and drug abuse).
Aiming to continue efforts in the prevention of COVID-19, especially the stability of work and production/business of factories/enterprises which have been reopened under the new normal, the Government, with the ILO support, launched the Standard Operating Procedure for Operations and Management of Factories/Enterprises Under New Normal in the Context of Covid-19 (Prakas No 002/22 K.B/Br.K.Kh.L) The ILO, with support from the Government of Japan, provided technical assistance in the development of the two policy tools for the entire process, following the support to draft the national OSH policy in the last biennium. In addition, the ILO contributed to the implementation of the 2nd National OSH Master Plan, for example, the comparative study on OSH policy and legal framework in light of C187, technical inputs to draft OSH law, Guidelines on Safety of Chemical Substances at the Workplace, National Asbestos Profiles and awareness campaign for the prevention of asbestos exposure at work, OSH awareness events (SafeDay), workplace OSH capacity building in construction sector applying ILO WISCON.
For the Standard Operating Procedure for Operations and Management of Factories/Enterprises Under New Normal in the Context of Covid-19 (Prakas No 002/22 K.B/Br.K.Kh.L), the ILO assisted in drafting the document as well as organizing the launching event in April 2022 with technical inputs.
